column1: # DOCTRINE-GAP-OWNERSHIP.1 — the triaged gap register (TRACKED; the ratchet's memory).
# Every RESIDUE hit from gap_ownership_sweep.py — i.e. every recorded gap the driver
# cannot mechanically resolve as FENCE / PROVENANCE / OWNED — must appear here with a
# ⛔ THE POINT: a gap that is merely WRITTEN DOWN is invisible. The founding case sat
# 58 commits in a decision record's prose. This file is what makes "recorded" and
# "tracked" the same thing. Own them; do NOT fix them here.
# Keys are sha1(path + NUL + normalized line)[:12] — stable under line movement, and
# deliberately UNSTABLE under an edit to the gap sentence itself (the claim changed ⇒
# FALSE-POSITIVE  the pattern matched non-gap text (legend prose, a symptom table, …)
# PROVENANCE      historical record, accurate as of its own entry — not open work
# BOUNDARY        a published/deliberate support boundary, documented for consumers
# DELIBERATE      a considered decision carrying its own stated rationale
# STALE-CLOSED    the record reads OPEN but the work is DONE (owner = closing commit)
# OWNED           a real gap already owned by a leaf (owner = leaf id)
# ROUTED          a real gap; a leaf was opened for it here (owner = leaf id)
